GLS.feature.resource-bars.title: Resource Bars
GLS.feature.resource-bars.hint: Replaces token bars with refractive glass, in-bar values, idle light motion, and damage and healing effects. Includes PF2e temporary HP and shield layers.
GLRB.Settings.EnabledBars.Name: Bars to replace
GLRB.Settings.EnabledBars.Hint: Whether the secondary bar (bar2) is drawn alongside the primary one. Whatever each token's bars are bound to is respected either way.
GLRB.Settings.Dividers.Name: Show dividers
GLRB.Settings.Dividers.Hint: Draw solid black divider lines across the primary fill and its empty track. Off draws a continuous pane, regardless of division mode.
GLRB.Settings.SegmentMode.Name: Division mode
GLRB.Settings.SegmentMode.Hint: How the primary bar is divided into plates. Divisions let players read health by position as well as by colour, which matters for colour-blind viewers.
GLRB.Settings.SegmentMode.PerHp: One plate per so many hit points
GLRB.Settings.Segments.Name: Divisions
GLRB.Settings.Segments.Hint: How many plates the primary bar is assembled from, when the division mode is a fixed number. 0 draws one continuous fill.
GLRB.Settings.SegmentSize.Name: Hit points per plate
GLRB.Settings.SegmentSize.Hint: Used when the division mode is one plate per so many hit points. A creature's plate count is its maximum divided by this, rounded up, so one plate means the same amount of damage on every creature. Capped at 60 plates.
GLRB.Settings.DividerWidth.Name: Divider thickness
GLRB.Settings.DividerWidth.Hint: Width of the solid black divider lines in screen pixels. A bar with many divisions caps the width to preserve visible fill.
GLRB.Settings.NumbersForce.Name: Force value display for players
GLRB.Settings.NumbersForce.Hint: Overrides each player's own "Show values" choice. It cannot reveal anything they could not already see: a token whose Display Bars hides its bars from a player still shows them no number, whatever this is set to. Your own setting is unaffected.
GLRB.Settings.LowThreshold.Name: Low-health threshold (%)
GLRB.Settings.LowThreshold.Hint: Below this fraction, the inset frame and fill carry a slow warning pulse.
GLRB.Settings.FloatingDeltas.Name: Floating damage numbers
GLRB.Settings.FloatingDeltas.Hint: Show the amount lost or gained as a number that rises off the bar. Off by default; dedicated modules cover this ground and some tables find it noisy.
GLRB.Settings.Pf2eLayers.Name: PF2e temp HP and shields
GLRB.Settings.Pf2eLayers.Hint: Draw temporary hit points as a bright ribbed shield band, and a raised shield as its own rail beneath the bar. Ignored outside Pathfinder 2e.
GLRB.Settings.BreakFx.Name: Guard-break fracture
GLRB.Settings.BreakFx.Hint: When the Initiative Tracker marks a creature's guard as broken, fracture its health bar with the same golden glass crack it puts on the token and the initiative card. Needs the Initiative Tracker feature; ignored without it.
GLRB.Settings.Bloom.Name: Bloom
GLRB.Settings.Bloom.Hint: Let highlights and impacts cast light past the edge of the bar. Costs one extra render pass over all bars together. Turn it off if the canvas struggles.
GLRB.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Motion
GLRB.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: How much the bars animate on your screen. This is your choice alone and does not affect anyone else at the table.
GLRB.Settings.Ramp.Name: Colour ramp
GLRB.Settings.Ramp.Hint: The default ramp runs green to red. The colour-blind-safe ramp runs blue to orange instead, avoiding the red/green axis entirely.
GLRB.Settings.NumberScale.Name: Value text size
GLRB.Settings.NumberScale.Hint: Scales the numeric readout and floating damage numbers. The in-bar readout fits within the token width and bar height, even at the largest size.
GLRB.Settings.Numbers.Name: Show values
GLRB.Settings.Numbers.Hint: When the numeric readout is drawn. This can never show more than the token's own Display Bars setting already permits: if the GM has hidden a token's bars from you, no number appears. The GM can also override this choice for the whole table.
GLRB.Settings.OffsetX.Name: Bar offset — horizontal
GLRB.Settings.OffsetX.Hint: Shifts every bar sideways, in grid squares (0.1 is a tenth of a square). Grid squares rather than pixels so the placement holds on scenes with different grid sizes. A token can override this in its own configuration.
GLRB.Settings.OffsetY.Name: Bar offset — vertical
GLRB.Settings.OffsetY.Hint: Shifts every bar up or down, in grid squares. Negative moves the stack up onto the token, positive moves it further below. A token can override this in its own configuration.
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetX.Name: Bar offset — horizontal
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetX.Hint: Grid squares. Leave blank to follow the world default shown in the field.
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetY.Name: Bar offset — vertical
GLRB.TokenConfig.OffsetY.Hint: Grid squares; negative moves the bars up onto the token. Leave blank to follow the world default shown in the field.
